source: Explicit user clarification: only evaluate the agent itself and its execution; exclude ordinary website, code-review and accessibility task-outcome checks.

changes.name: anthropics/skills
changes.label: capability.evaluation
changes.reason: README documents testing web apps and advises users to test skills; no owned mechanism measures an agent or agent execution. User explicitly excludes ordinary task-outcome testing.

changes.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
changes.label: capability.evaluation
changes.reason: Documented page/visual/a11y checks and Chrome/browser traces do not clearly establish observation of agent execution; generic trace wording is a boundary, no longer a forced positive.

changes.name: mem0ai/mem0
changes.label: capability.evaluation
changes.reason: Owned mem0-test-integration validates memory SDK integration; README does not establish that it measures agent behavior or execution. Product benchmark numbers and another linked benchmarks repository do not establish owned agent evaluation. Boundary under new user scope.

changes.name: mindfold-ai/Trellis
changes.label: capability.evaluation
changes.reason: README code/diff/spec checks, lint, type checks and tests validate task artifacts, not the agent itself or its execution; task journals are project memory rather than evaluation. User explicitly excludes code-review/outcome testing.

changes.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
changes.label: capability.evaluation
changes.reason: Bundled scientific-script tests, reviewed examples and repository CI do not establish measurement of agent behavior or observation of agent execution. New independently annotated negative under the user boundary; evaluation was not a scored key in the old gold.

changes.name: wshobson/agents
changes.label: capability.evaluation
changes.reason: Owned plugin-eval includes static skill checks and optional LLM/Monte Carlo modes, but the supplied README does not establish whether those modes measure agent execution or only skill/document quality. New boundary annotation under user scope; evaluation was not a scored key in the old gold.
